poc_summary: Scope: 6-week POC comparing Redwood hosted streaming vs incumbent (OpenAI) for Loopline chat agents.
Traffic: replayed 12k sessions, 120 TPS burst tests, simulated 3K concurrent users.
Goals: meet interactive latency SLOs (first-byte streaming <150ms p50, <400ms p95), stable tool-calls under 500ms p95, maintain token cost within 1.4x historic baseline.
Success criteria: UX perceived latency <250ms for typical responses; no more than 1% reconnects/stream stalls under load.
poc_results: Redwood hosted streaming: first-byte latency p50=72ms, p95=210ms (256 token sample).
Incumbent streaming: first-byte latency p50=240ms, p95=920ms — frequent spikes during bursts.
Tool-calling (calendar query + 1 connector): Redwood end-to-end median 320ms, p95 480ms. Incumbent median 610ms, p95 1200ms (timeouts observed).
Throughput: Redwood sustained 120 TPS with <0.5% stream reconnections. Incumbent hit 200ms to 1s jitter and 3.8% reconnects under same pattern.
Cost: projected token cost ~1.2x incumbent at current config but expected to drop with batching + caching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
